Name: Week
Equation: TIME + TIME STEP
Description: Board week being played: the step from TIME to TIME + 1 is week TIME + 1.

Name: Customer demand
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Demand regime = 0, Base demand + (Step demand - Base demand) * STEP(1, Step week - TIME STEP), IF THEN ELSE(Demand regime = 1, MAX(0, RANDOM NORMAL(0, 1000, Demand mean, Demand sd, Demand seed)), Demand data))
Description: What customers ask of the retailer this week.

Name: In window
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(TIME >= Test start, 1, 0)
Description: 1 once the counted window has begun.

Name: Retailer available
Equation: Retailer on hand + Retailer shipment pipe 2
Description: On hand after this week's receipt (step 1).

Name: Retailer end on hand
Equation: Retailer available - Retailer shipments out * TIME STEP
Description: On hand at the end of the week (step 3).

Name: Retailer end backlog
Equation: Retailer backlog + (Retailer orders received - Retailer shipments out) * TIME STEP
Description: Backlog at the end of the week (step 3).

Name: Retailer inventory
Equation: Retailer end on hand - Retailer end backlog
Description: Effective inventory at the end of the week (negative when in backlog).

Name: Retailer updated expectation
Equation: Retailer expected demand + Retailer theta * (Retailer orders received - Retailer expected demand) * TIME STEP
Description: Expected demand after this week's orders.

Name: Retailer supply line
Equation: Retailer order pipe 1 + Wholesaler end backlog + Wholesaler shipments out * TIME STEP + Retailer shipment pipe 1
Description: Ordered and not yet received, including the supplier's backlog (end of week).

Name: Retailer equilibrium S prime
Equation: Initial inventory + Retailer beta * Initial demand * 3 * TIME STEP
Description: Desired stock that keeps the starting equilibrium flat.

Name: Retailer S prime used
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Use equilibrium S prime = 1, Retailer equilibrium S prime, Retailer S prime)
Description: Desired stock in use.

Name: Retailer AA order
Equation: MAX(0, Retailer updated expectation + Retailer alpha * (Retailer S prime used - Retailer inventory - Retailer beta * Retailer supply line))
Description: Anchoring and adjustment (Sterman 1989).

Name: Retailer base stock order
Equation: MAX(0, Retailer base stock level - Retailer inventory - Retailer supply line) / TIME STEP
Description: Order up to the base-stock level.

Name: Retailer rule order
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Retailer policy = 1, Retailer base stock order, Retailer AA order)
Description: Order the policy asks for.

Name: Retailer cost rate
Equation: Holding cost * Retailer end on hand + Backlog cost * Retailer end backlog
Description: Cost this week, on the end-of-week stocks (board game).

Name: Wholesaler available
Equation: Wholesaler on hand + Wholesaler shipment pipe 2
Description: On hand after this week's receipt (step 1).

Name: Wholesaler end on hand
Equation: Wholesaler available - Wholesaler shipments out * TIME STEP

Description: Effective inventory at the end of the week (negative when in backlog).

Name: Wholesaler updated expectation
Equation: Wholesaler expected demand + Wholesaler theta * (Wholesaler orders received - Wholesaler expected demand) * TIME STEP
Description: Expected demand after this week's orders.

Name: Wholesaler supply line
Equation: Wholesaler order pipe 1 + Distributor end backlog + Distributor shipments out * TIME STEP + Wholesaler shipment pipe 1
Description: Ordered and not yet received, including the supplier's backlog (end of week).

Name: Wholesaler equilibrium S prime

Description: Desired stock that keeps the starting equilibrium flat.

Name: Wholesaler S prime used
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Use equilibrium S prime = 1, Wholesaler equilibrium S prime, Wholesaler S prime)
Description: Desired stock in use.

Name: Wholesaler AA order

Name: Wholesaler base stock order

Description: Order up to the base-stock level.

Description: Cost this week, on the end-of-week stocks (board game).

Name: Demand variance
Equation: ZIDZ(Demand sumsq, Window weeks) - ZIDZ(Demand sum, Window weeks) ^ 2
Description: Variance of customer demand in the window.

Name: Retailer order variance
Equation: ZIDZ(Retailer order sumsq, Window weeks) - ZIDZ(Retailer order sum, Window weeks) ^ 2
Description: Variance of orders placed in the window.

Name: Retailer bullwhip
Equation: ZIDZ(Retailer order variance, Demand variance)
Description: Variance of orders placed over variance of customer demand.

Name: Retailer average backlog
Equation: ZIDZ(Retailer window backlog, Window weeks)
Description: Average backlog in the window.

Name: Wholesaler order variance
Equation: ZIDZ(Wholesaler order sumsq, Window weeks) - ZIDZ(Wholesaler order sum, Window weeks) ^ 2
Description: Variance of orders placed in the window.

Name: Wholesaler bullwhip
Equation: ZIDZ(Wholesaler order variance, Demand variance)
Description: Variance of orders placed over variance of customer demand.

Name: Wholesaler average backlog
Equation: ZIDZ(Wholesaler window backlog, Window weeks)
Description: Average backlog in the window.

Name: Distributor order variance
Equation: ZIDZ(Distributor order sumsq, Window weeks) - ZIDZ(Distributor order sum, Window weeks) ^ 2
Description: Variance of orders placed in the window.

Name: Distributor bullwhip

Name: Distributor average backlog

Description: Average backlog in the window.

Name: Factory order variance

Description: Variance of orders placed over variance of customer demand.

Name: Factory average backlog
Equation: ZIDZ(Factory window backlog, Window weeks)
Description: Average backlog in the window.

Name: Chain window cost
Equation: Retailer window cost + Wholesaler window cost + Distributor window cost + Factory window cost
Description: Total cost of the chain in the window (the primary metric).

Name: Chain cost
Equation: Retailer cost + Wholesaler cost + Distributor cost + Factory cost
Description: Total cost of the chain so far.

Name: Fill rate
Equation: ZIDZ(Retailer window shipped, Retailer window demand)
Description: Share of customer demand met from stock in the window.

Name: Equilibrium gap
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Week < Step week, IF THEN ELSE(Use equilibrium S prime = 1, ABS(Retailer orders placed - Base demand) + ABS(Wholesaler orders placed - Base demand) + ABS(Distributor orders placed - Base demand) + ABS(Factory orders placed - Base demand), 0), 0)
Description: Total distance of the orders from equilibrium before the step, when the equilibrium desired stock is in use (T2).

Name: Amplification holds
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Retailer peak order < Wholesaler peak order, IF THEN ELSE(Wholesaler peak order < Distributor peak order, IF THEN ELSE(Distributor peak order < Factory peak order, 1, 0), 0), 0)
Description: 1 if the highest order grows at every stage going upstream (T3).

Name: Peaks later upstream
Equation: IF THEN ELSE(Retailer peak time <= Wholesaler peak time, IF THEN ELSE(Wholesaler peak time <= Distributor peak time, IF THEN ELSE(Distributor peak time <= Factory peak time, IF THEN ELSE(Retailer peak time < Factory peak time, 1, 0), 0), 0), 0)
Description: 1 if the highest order comes no earlier at each stage going upstream, and strictly later at the factory (T3).
